steps: Sign in to Mailgun and open Dashboard > Account Settings > API Keys (menu names can change)
Use your main account API key - the check lists your domains, which a domain 'sending key' cannot do (a valid sending key would look wrong)
unverified: the EU host api.eu.mailgun.net (EU accounts: save your own recipe with `stuntkey add`)

least_privilege.summary: For sending only, a domain sending key is safer - but it cannot pass this check. Keep the main key out of apps that only send.
